posts.title: Sandboxing pre-commit
posts.description: pre-commit is a tool that is often a prerequisite for contributing to Python upstream projects. It installs as a git pre-commit hook and runs various checks on commit, using tools installed in a set of virtualenvs that it automatically manages. In other words, it is a Remote Code Execution engine running with the permissions of your own user, and with read and write access to all your information
